title: Custom Drug Dilution Assay
author: Opentrons
materials: Specify your parameters on this page.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place a Corning 96‑well plate (Drug Dilution 0.1 µM) in slot 1, an Opentrons 300 µL tip rack in slot 2, the stock plate in slot 10, a 90 mL Axygen reservoir in slot 11, and the three 96‑well dilution plates (10 µM, 1 µM, 0.1 µM) in the remaining slots as shown in the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the positions of the tip racks, plates, reservoir, and both the p300‑multi‑channel pipette (GEN1) and the p10‑multi‑channel pipette with calibration tips.

steps.title: Add 100 µL media to plates
steps.instruction: With the p300‑multi‑channel pipette and tips from column 1, dispense 100 µL of media into every column of the three dilution plates (10 µM, 1 µM, 0.1 µM). After each four column transfers, return the tips to the tip rack and pick them up again to ensure a good seal.

steps.title: Perform 10 µL drug dilutions
steps.instruction: Using the p10‑multi‑channel pipette and the same tip set for each column, transfer 10 µL of drug stock from the stock plate in slot 10 to the corresponding wells of the first dilution plate, then continue to the second and third dilution plates, keeping the same tip for the entire column.

steps.title: Add 100 µL reservoir solution
steps.instruction: Switch back to the p300‑multi‑channel pipette, load tips from column 2, and dispense 100 µL from the reservoir in slot 11 into each column of the three dilution plates, replacing the tip set after every four column transfers as done previously.

steps.title: Upload and run protocol
steps.instruction: In the OT App, upload the protocol file, verify that the deck map matches the physical setup, and press “Run” to execute the liquid‑handling steps.
